examples.arabic: اخويا بيجيب اللمبة الجديدة من الاوضة
examples.english: My brother brings the new lamp from the room.
examples.transliteration: akhouya beygeeb el lamba el gedeeda min el oda

examples.arabic: منى كانت بتجري وسط زحمة خان الخليلي الصبح بدري، وعقلها كله في اللمبة النادرة اللي لازم تلاقيها قبل ميعاد اجتماعها المهم.
examples.english: Mona was running through the crowded Khan el-Khalili early in the morning, her mind completely focused on the rare lamp she absolutely had to find before her important meeting.
examples.transliteration: Mona kanet betegri west za7met Khan el-Khalili el-sob7 badry, we 3a2laha kollo fel-lamba el-nadera elle lazim tela2eeha abl me3ad egtema3aha el-mohem.
examples.storyTitle: Mona's Journey in Khan el-Khalili: A Morning Full of Greetings
